releaseNotes:
Hubble 1.5.1

Hubble 1.5.1: Camera controls and smoother workspace editing

- Add the CCC camera-control sheet with per-camera and all-camera enable/disable toggles, recording controls, and ND/ISO up and down actions. Inactive feedback uses the button's normal background.
- Search action choices while typing, accept or autofill with Enter, and open or close choices with Option, including Ross source and destination cells.
- Clear validation notices into a separate Cleared section while retaining red cell highlights, and jump directly from a notice to its affected field. Removing invalid values clears stale labels and linked errors immediately.
- Fix the blank screen after deleting many or all buttons, including workspaces with hidden sheet rows.
- Apply settings and workbook edits immediately while saving in the background, with recovery when saving fails.
- Preserve button sheets, sheet-specific actions, camera settings, and layouts through workspace export/import and full-spreadsheet transfer.
- Set up and edit remembered Stream Deck devices while disconnected, assign future Button IDs, and preserve button artwork.
- Add the DIT Browse grid-view action and improve DIT Browse and Ross OGP connection recovery.
